items.source: Return the source controller that contains @RequestMapping methods.
items.translation: 返回包含 @RequestMapping 方法的源控制器。

items.source: Information describing an endpoint that can be exposed over Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux. Mappings should be discovered directly from getController() and ExposableEndpoint.getOperations() should always return an empty collection.
items.translation: 描述可通过 Spring MVC 或 Spring WebFlux 暴露的端点的信息。映射应直接从 getController() 发现，且 ExposableEndpoint.getOperations() 始终应返回空集合。

items.source: since 3.3.3 in favor of @Endpoint and @WebEndpoint support
items.translation: 自 3.3.3 版本起，支持使用 @Endpoint 和 @WebEndpoint。

items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。
